Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Efficient use of energy, environmentally-friendly mobility and security in a connected world we solve some of the most critical challenges that our society faces while taking a conscientious approach to the use of natural resources. 2 Internship - Electro-Acoustics and Signal Processing (f/m/div) Job IdHRC1455142JobfamilieResearch & DevelopmentBeschäftigungsartVollzeit / TeilzeitVertragsdauerBefristetArbeitsplatztypHybridEinsteigen alsStudent*in/Praktikant*in/Trainee#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. The future won't wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Expert Collaboration: Work with experts at a global semiconductor company and leading MEMS microphone supplier to develop and characterize next-generation audio technologies

 * Electro-Acoustic Support: Support the team with a strong focus on electro-acoustic lab work and early-stage concept development

 * Product Insights: Gain insights into the development of MEMS audio products for smartphones, hearables, IoT and automotive applications

 * Performance Analysis: Measure and analyze performance parameters as well as audio quality of existing and next-generation microphones

 * Novel Concepts: Work on novel sensing concepts, experiment design, fixture preparation, data processing and visualization (e.g., Python, MATLAB) and listening tests

 * Innovation Contribution: Help shape the next generation of microphone solutions

Further Information

Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)

Duration: min. 12 months

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

 * Education: Motivated and committed master student (f/m/div) from the field of Electronics or Electrical Engineering with focus on Audio Engineering or similar

 * Knowledge: Background in acoustics and signal processing

 * Lab Skills: Hands-on experience in laboratory environments

 * Curiosity: Curiosity for state-of-the-art developments of microphone solutions in the semiconductor industry

 * Language Skills: Good English skills

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2025.pdf).

Please attach the following documents (German or English) to your application:

 * Motivation letter

 * CV

 * Highest completed educational certificate (Matura certificate for Bachelor students, Bachelor certificate for Master students)

 * Reference letter (optional)

jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

Wir machen das Leben einfacher, sicherer und umweltfreundlicher, mit Technik, die mehr leistet, weniger verbraucht und für alle verfügbar ist. Mikroelektronik von Infineon ist der Schlüssel für eine lebenswerte Zukunft. Wir achten auf schonenden Umgang mit natürlichen Ressourcen und lösen gesellschaftliche Herausforderungen: Effiziente Energienutzung, umweltgerechte Mobilität und Sicherheit in einer vernetzten Welt. 2 Staff Engineer Application Stress Test Methodologies (f/m/div) ID: HRC1166867

Join us at KAI and become a key player in the semiconductor industry, where every design and test brings us closer to a sustainable, electrified future! As our new Staff Engineer specializing in Application Stress Test Methodologies, you¿ll dive into the world of next-generation wide-bandgap power semiconductors, designing innovative test systems that explore performance under extreme conditions.

At KAI, we strive to create pioneering reliability test methods and systems for robust power semiconductor technologies. Your know-how in designing and developing test systems will help us push our technology to its limits while collaborating with a team of innovators.

Your new responsibilities:

Develop and design advanced power electronic circuits through simulations and concept studies

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather and manage system requirements effectively

Transform designs into hardware, overseeing the complete implementation process, and supervising the manufacturing phase

Evaluate and validate designs within an industrial laboratory setting

Lead stress testing using both established and newly developed test systems

Document designs, concepts, and results with clarity and precision

You are a hands-on innovator with a passion for high-performing power electronic systems. You thrive on bringing ideas to life, blending technical understanding with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Your toolkit for success includes:

Master's / PhD in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

Strong expertise in SPICE and system-level simulations of power electronic circuits

Proven experience in PCB design using industry-standard tools like ALTIUM Designer

Practical experience with power electronic hardware design, from concept to laboratory validation

Excellent communication skills in English and/or German

The ability to lead and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative workspace

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry, at least employment group G (https://www.feei.at/leistungen/informations-service/mindestlohne-und-gehalter). jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Associate Principal, Product OperationsStellenbeschreibung:Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionJob Ref ID: JR0087194We are on the lookout for an Associate Principal, Product Operations (Enterprise Device Management) to join our Restaurant vertical team in Berlin on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.As part of our Vendor Team, you’ll be the driving force behind the success of thousands of restaurants, shops, and local businesses. Your contributions will empower vendors with advanced tools to manage their operations, boosting their visibility and reach. Every feature you help build will create growth opportunities for businesses of all sizes, strengtheningThe Global Vendor Operations team at Delivery Hero consists of smart and driven people from all around the world who work closely together with our entities worldwide to ensure each and every local or regional operations team performs in their most efficient way. jobs.description: Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Every application is personally reviewed and individually evaluated by the recruitment team. Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.We at Allianz SE are recognized as a trusted partner for protecting and growing your most valuable assets, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, including property and casualty insurance, life and health insurance, and asset management services, tailored to meet the various needs of individual and corporate clients worldwide. From our international headquarters, we orchestrate global operations, set strategic directions, and ensure cohesive implementation across our international subsidiaries. We are committed to innovation and digital transformation, driving initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency, reinforcing our position as a leader in the financial services industry.For more about Allianz SE, Click Here.We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions. Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our customers and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture. Therefore, applicants with severe disabilities are welcome and will be given special consideration if equally qualified.We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.Welcome to AllianzAt Group Audit, we act as a trusted partner to Allianz Group by protecting and improving the organization through strong business insight, technology expertise, and professional excellence. In this Senior Internal Auditor role, you will operate within and combine the two key disciplines — Investments and Information Technology. Leveraging your expertise across the investment value chain alongside strong capabilities in technology, data, and AI risk, you will evaluate governance and control frameworks, anticipate emerging risks, and contribute to strengthening the internal control environment across Allianz entities.What awaits you as Senior Internal Auditor - Investments & Information Technology (m/f/d)You will lead risk-based audits across investment management, technology, data, and AI/ML topics.Key responsibilities include:- Plan, lead, and execute audits across investment management, asset management activities, IT systems, infrastructure, and technology-enabled transformation- Assess governance, business processes, transactions, workflows, controls, and regulatory compliance to identify key risks and control deficiencies- Evaluate investment risks covering portfolio management, trading, operations, valuation, outsourcing, and related control environments- Assess technology and digital risks, including identity and access management, resilience, third-party risk, data governance, and AI controls- Use data analytics, automation, and AI-assisted audit techniques to enhance audit coverage and insights- Communicate results clearly, write concise audit reports, agree pragmatic actions, and follow up on implementationWhat you bring as Senior Internal Auditor - Investments & Information Technology (m/f/d)- Master's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Quantitative Methods, IT, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Informatics, or equivalent professional experience- 5-6 years of experience in financial services, investment or asset management, insurance, audit, risk management, consulting, IT audit, or IT risk management- Good understanding of insurance related investment processes and risks, including governance, portfolio management, trading, operations, valuation, outsourcing, and regulation- Solid understanding of technology risks and controls, including data governance, AI/ML, enterprise IT risk, and frameworks such as COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001, ITIL, or CSA CCM- Knowledge of relevant financial services and technology regulations, including DORA, EBA ICT/Security Guidelines, GDPR, and insurance related investment management requirements- Sound knowledge of audit principles, risk assessment, internal controls, and risk management concepts- Ability to analyze complex topics, challenge assumptions, and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations- Strong English communication skills and ability to explain business, investment, and technical topics clearly to different stakeholders- High integrity, ownership, resilience, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to travelPreferred qualifications:- Certifications such as CIA, CISA, CFA, FRM, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CDPSE, or equivalent are a plus- Experience with AI governance and tools, IT platforms, DORA, investment related tools/systems, and/or data-driven audit skills and techniques is important- Additional languages besides English are a plus- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plusExperience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solutionOur highlights for you- Health & Wellbeing: Company health insurance, sports and wellness programmes, and preventive health measures lay the foundation for your physical and mental well-being.- Compensation: Collective agreement bonuses, a company pension plan, capital-forming benefits, and employee shares make our compensation package particularly attractive. On top of that, you directly participate in the company's success.- Time & Flexibility: Our "New Work" model helps you achieve a better work-life balance. We work flexibly - hybrid, mobile, and on-site.- Career Development: Together, we create a personal development plan and give you the opportunity to gain cross-functional and cross-border experience.A full overview of what makes us an attractive employer: careers.allianz.com/benefitsStart date: As soon as possibleInterested and does this sound like an environment you'd like to work in? Then apply now as Senior Internal Auditor - Investments & Information Technology (m/f/d) online on our careers page - careers.allianz.com.For technical and HR questions, reach out to your recruiter: Nasir Mehrzad Balach at nasir.mehrzad-balach@allianz.deTo learn about our recruitment process: Allianz SE Recruitment Process108455 | Audit | Professional | Allianz SE | Full-Time | Permanent
